description: wt - git worktree helper for PowerShell: pick, cd, add, check out, rename, remove and clean worktrees, Claude Code's included.
post_install: # The registry PSModulePath was just extended; this process still has the old value.
$mods = if (Get-Command modulesdir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { modulesdir $global } else { Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $dir))) 'modules' }
# 'wt' is also Windows Terminal's launcher (wt.exe). PowerShell only prefers the function once the module
# is imported, so auto-loading cannot be relied on: import it from the profile, every session.
$line = 'Import-Module PSWorktree -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  # wt: git worktree helper (scoop install psworktree)'
# And make it available right now, no new shell needed.
post_uninstall: Write-Host "The 'Import-Module PSWorktree' line in $($PROFILE.CurrentUserAllHosts) is harmless now (-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) - delete it when convenient."
notes: 'wt' works in this shell already and in every new one (imported from your PowerShell profile).
Type 'wt --help' to start. Windows Terminal's own launcher is still reachable as 'wt.exe'.
